name: app-3d-anatomy-athlete-analytics-dashboard-on-tilted-monitor
title: Sports-analytics dashboard with a translucent 3D athlete model, fatigue gauges and a right panel of forecasts, on a tilted blue monitor
whatItIs: A blue monitor tilted in perspective showing a light dashboard with a large glassy anatomical model of a crouching athlete, floating metric cards (840N dynamic fatigue), left tiles with dials and progress bars, and a right 'Detailed analytics' panel with recovery forecast lines, an 87% predictive alert and status chips, with a small logo pill.
whatItMeans: Scientific and refined; the glass body model makes data feel physical.
techniques: Place a translucent 3D body at the centre.
Attach metric callouts to body parts.
Show dials and lines in side panels.
Use a pale UI on a dark blue monitor.

vocabulary.definition: A card linked to a part of an object.
A high-risk percentage with a status chip.
